title: Tender Beef Birria Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional Indian cuisine, featuring tender beef birria in a flavorful Indian-inspired taco.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger paste, garam masala, and birria spice blend. Cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, coconut milk, salt, and water. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Shred beef with two forks and return to pot. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Warm tacos with the beef birria and serve with desired toppings.
